verdict.rationale: Pigment's finance use-case page says data is integrated through native connectors and scheduled imports. That points to automated ingestion without manual exports, but it never names QuickBooks, Xero, or NetSuite, and it never describes accounting actuals landing in the model. Missing for 10: a documented connector for QuickBooks, Xero, or NetSuite; a description of how actuals sync into the model and how often; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect my accounting platform (QuickBooks, Xero, or NetSuite) and actuals land in the model without manual exports

citations.quote: easily integrated through native connectors, open APIs, and scheduled imports.
